title: 第11章 不行这样不行不能这样第12章 宗主目光死死锁定柳师师
slug: 救了元婴宗主夫人醒后她急了

;;
“闭嘴！闭嘴！我不听！”
柳师师双手死死捂住耳朵，脸颊上的红晕一路蔓延到了白皙的脖颈根处。
如果现在手边有一把剑，她发誓绝对会先一剑砍了这个大言不惭的逆徒。
“行行行，闭嘴就闭嘴。”
陆长生嘴上虽然还在没大没小地贫着，手底下的动作却干脆利落，一点没慢。
他一把拽住那一床凌乱不堪的丝绸被褥，里头还混杂着某种不可描述的甜腻气息，三两下便将其卷成了一个硕大的春卷形状。
紧接着，他指尖一弹，一缕赤红的火苗窜出，瞬间将这团被褥包裹。
火光跳跃，发出细微的劈啪声。这玩意儿若是留在这里，那就是铁证如山，等外面的人闯进来，他们就是长了一百张嘴都说不清。
眼看灰烬纷纷扬扬落下，陆长生转头看向还站在原地发怔的柳师师。
这位平日里高高在上的师尊此刻脸色红一阵白一阵，连平日里整齐的云鬓都散乱了几缕。
“师尊，别发呆了啊。”陆长生拍了拍手上的灰，忍不住压低声音催促道，“赶紧毁尸灭迹，外头估计快等不及了。”
被这一声低喝惊醒，柳师师肩膀微微一颤。她深吸了一口气，饱满的胸口剧烈起伏了几下，强行压下心头那股想要把陆长生大卸八块的冲动。
她很清楚，现在两人是一条绳上的蚂蚱，真被撞破了，谁都落不了好。
她抬起手，纤细的玉指在空气中飞快划动。随着指尖灵力流转，一道道繁复晦涩的符文在半空中凭空浮现，散发出微弱的荧光。
只是，往日里那稳如磐石、画符如行云流水般的手，此刻却在不受控制地微微发抖。
悬在空中的那些符文，硬生生被画得歪歪扭扭，像极了刚学写字连笔都握不住的小学徒。
“啧。”
陆长生在一旁抱起双臂，眉头顿时拧在了一起，毫不留情地开启了吐槽模式：
“师尊，稍微稳一点行不行？咱们现在是在玩命，不是在涂鸦。这结界要是补漏了，咱们俩今天都得身败名裂。”

“你给我闭嘴！”
柳师师羞愤欲死，狠狠剐了他一眼，银牙咬得咯咯作响，“还不是因为你……刚才一直要修炼！”
若说眼神能杀人，陆长生这会儿只怕已经被千刀万剐了。她不再理会这逆徒，银牙一咬，直接咬破了舌尖。
一丝腥甜在口腔中弥漫，她猛地将一口精血喷在指尖之上，借着这股血气，强行催动体内还在四处乱窜的灵力。
嗡——
伴随着一声低沉的嗡鸣，这一次画出的血色符文红光大作。一道肉眼可见的淡金色光幕顺着墙壁迅速蔓延，重新将整个听雨轩笼罩其中。
原有的结界漏洞被彻底修补严实，甚至因为加了精血的缘故，光幕上流转的色泽比之前还要深邃几分，显得更加稳固。
做完这一切，柳师师的身子猛地晃了晃，原本就透着几分潮红的脸色瞬间变得苍白如纸。
“行了，结界补上了。”她虚弱地抬起手，扶住了一旁的雕花床柱，眼神有些没有焦距地涣散开来，
“除非他直接动手强攻，否则哪怕是元婴期的神识，也休想探进来半点。”
“很好。不愧是师尊。”
陆长生点了点头，脸上的嬉皮笑脸在一瞬间收敛得干干净净，取而代之的是一种近乎冷酷的严谨。他往前迈了两步，直接走到柳师师面前。
柳师师还没反应过来，就见他微微低头，鼻尖几乎贴到了她的脖颈处，像只猎犬一样用力嗅了嗅。
“你做什么？”柳师师本能地往后缩了一下。
陆长生直起身，松开手，指了指柳师师平坦的小腹，语气严肃得像是在给病人确诊绝症：
“师尊，你的丹田里、经脉里，到处都是我的灵力气息。这种阴阳交汇留下的痕迹太明显了，结界防得住神识，可防不住一会儿当面盘问，太容易被发现了。”
柳师师愣了一下，低头看了看自己。那股淡淡的、属于陆长生的陌生气息，确实如同附骨之疽般缠绕在她周身。
“那……那怎么办？”向来遇事不惊的柳师师，这下是真的慌了神。
“运功排出去。”
陆长生指了指身后那张宽大的拔步床，“你去床上，盘膝打坐，把所有的异气全都清出来。”

紧接着，他又指了指床榻下方地砖上的一个蒲团，“我坐地上运功，咱们抓紧时间。”

"Shut up! Shut up! I won't listen!"
Liu Shishi covered his ears with both hands, and the blush on his cheeks spread all the way to the base of his fair neck.
If she had a sword at hand now, she swore that she would kill this shameless rebel first with one strike.
"Okay, okay, just shut up, just shut up."
Although Lu Changsheng's mouth was still sloppy, the movements under his hands were crisp and neat, not slow at all.
He grabbed the messy silk quilt, which was still mixed with some indescribable sweet smell, and rolled it into a huge spring roll shape in a few strokes.
Then, with a flick of his fingertips, a wisp of red flames burst out, instantly wrapping the blanket.
The fire danced and made a subtle crackling sound. If this thing stays here, it will be irrefutable evidence. When people from outside break in, they will not be able to explain it even if they have a hundred mouths.
Seeing the ashes falling, Lu Changsheng turned to look at Master Liu who was still standing there in shock.
The usually aloof master's face turned red and white at this moment, and even his usually neat hair on the temples had a few strands scattered.
"Master, don't be in a daze." Lu Changsheng patted the ashes on his hands and couldn't help but lower his voice and urged, "Hurry up and destroy the corpses. I guess the people outside can't wait any longer."
Awakened by this low shout, Master Liu's shoulders trembled slightly. She took a deep breath, her full chest rose and fell violently several times, and she suppressed the urge in her heart to tear Lu Changsheng into pieces.
She knew very well that now the two of them were grasshoppers on the same rope. If they were really broken, no one would be able to fall off.
She raised her hand and moved her slender jade fingers rapidly in the air. As the spiritual energy flows through the fingertips, complex and obscure runes emerge out of thin air in mid-air, emitting a faint fluorescence.
However, the hand that used to be as steady as a rock and draw the symbols like flowing water was now shaking slightly uncontrollably.
The runes hanging in the air were drawn crookedly, like a little apprentice who had just learned to write and couldn't even hold a pen.
"Tsk."
Lu Changsheng crossed his arms at the side, his brows suddenly knitted together, and he started complaining mercilessly:
"Master, can you be a little more steady? We are risking our lives now, not graffiti. If this barrier is not repaired, both of us will be ruined today."
"Shut up!"
Master Liu was so ashamed and angry that he gave him a fierce look, his silver teeth clenched, "It's not because you...have been practicing just now!"
If looks could kill, Lu Changsheng might have been cut to pieces by a thousand cuts right now. She ignored the traitor and bit her silver teeth, biting the tip of her tongue.
A hint of fishy sweetness filled her mouth, and she suddenly sprayed a mouthful of blood on her fingertips. With this blood, she forcibly activated the spiritual power that was still running around in her body.
Buzz——
Accompanied by a low buzzing sound, the blood-colored runes drawn this time glowed with red light. A pale golden light curtain visible to the naked eye spread rapidly along the wall and once again enveloped the entire Tingyuxuan.
The original loopholes in the barrier have been completely repaired, and even because of the addition of blood essence, the color flowing on the light screen is darker than before, making it appear more stable.
After doing all this, Master Liu's body swayed violently, and his face, which was originally flushed, instantly turned pale as paper.
"Okay, the barrier has been repaired." She weakly raised her hand and supported the carved bedpost beside her, her eyes unfocused and unfocused.
"Unless he attacks directly, even the consciousness of the Nascent Soul stage will not be able to penetrate even a little bit."
"Very good. As expected of Master."
Lu Changsheng nodded, and the playful smile on his face disappeared in an instant, replaced by an almost cold rigor. He took two steps forward and walked directly to Master Liu.
Before Master Liu could react, he saw him lowering his head slightly.The tip of his nose almost touched her neck, sniffing hard like a hound.
"What are you doing?" Liu Shishi shrank back instinctively.
Lu Changsheng straightened up, released his hand, pointed at Liu Shishi's flat belly, and spoke in a serious tone, as if he was diagnosing a terminal illness for a patient:
"Master, your Dantian and meridians are full of my spiritual energy. The traces left by this intersection of yin and yang are too obvious. The barrier can prevent spiritual consciousness, but it cannot prevent you from being interrogated face to face for a while. It is too easy to be discovered."
Master Liu was stunned for a moment and looked down at himself. That faint, unfamiliar aura belonging to Lu Changsheng was indeed wrapped around her like a gangrene attached to her bones.
"Then... what should we do?" Master Liu, who had always been calm when things happened, was really panicked now.
"Exhaust the luck."
Lu Changsheng pointed to the large bed behind him, "Go to the bed, sit cross-legged and meditate, and clear out all the foreign energy."
Then, he pointed to a futon on the floor tiles under the bed, "I'm going to sit on the ground to do my exercises, let's hurry up."
